notes.title: 🌾 Dive into VR Farming Fun with Across the Valley – Now 50% Off
notes.content:
Dear VR Farmers and Nature Lovers,

Looking for a relaxing escape in VR? Across the Valley offers just that – a simple and enjoyable farming experience that lets you cultivate your own virtual farm. Unlike other VR games, Across the Valley employs teleport movement, ensuring a comfortable and accessible experience for all players, without the need for free locomotion.

Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of the countryside as you plant seeds, tend to your crops, and care for your animals. Whether you're a seasoned VR gamer or new to virtual reality, Across the Valley offers an accessible and enjoyable experience for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43309951/5001b106c6d2295a0fc028079d22aae73da5c42c.png[/img]

And now is the perfect time to dive in! With a 50% discount, there's never been a better opportunity to experience the charm of virtual farming. Join us in celebrating the Steam Farming Fest and discover the joys of Across the Valley at a fraction of the cost.

So, grab your VR headset and prepare to embark on a relaxing farming adventure. Your virtual farm is waiting!

Happy farming,
FusionPlay

notes.title: Update 1.1 for Across the Valley
notes.content:
Greetings, farmers! We're back with an update that will take your gaming and streaming experience up a notch! We are excited to introduce LIV-support in Across the Valley 1.1 - a fantastic new feature that lets streamers like you add a virtual avatar to the game world or even appear as part of the action through a green screen setup.

👥 Connect with Your Audience Like Never Before

With LIV integration, you can now fully immerse your viewers by bringing a virtual "you" into the enchanting world of Across the Valley. It's a great way to make your streams more engaging and interactive, allowing your audience to join you on your magical journey like never before.

🐞 Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements

We've been hard at work addressing issues to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience. The update includes various bug fixes and performance improvements that will make your adventure through the valley even more seamless.

📈 Improved Tracking

We understand the importance of fluid interactions in the game. That's why we've improved tracking capabilities to ensure your virtual avatar moves naturally in response to your actions, making your streaming sessions feel even more realistic.

🌄 Adventure Awaits - Update Now!

Join us in the rural world of Across the Valley and explore your charming ranch with the latest 1.1 update. Whether you're a seasoned streamer or just starting out, LIV integration is sure to add a touch of magic to your broadcasts.

Happy farming!

The FusionPlay Team

notes.title: Patch Note Summary – Launch Patches
notes.content:
Dear Community, here is a list of fixes and changes that we rolled out via patches since the release date of Across the Valley. These items reflect all changes that have been made since the press preview version was sent out to the media before the launch. The changes were applied over 4 small patches during the last to weeks, the last one being deployed just now.

[h2][i]Patch Notes, Patches 1.0.3 – 1.06[/i][/h2]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added some easter egg events to the farm, they occur on different spots but very rarely (watch out for the bird outside, the mouse in the house, Konrad the Kitten in the barn and some fishes in the pond.)
[*] Added more animation variations for all animals
[*] Added invert grab & teleport buttons option in the options menu
[/list]

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced task board text visibility and readability
[*] Adjusted volumes of some sounds
[*] Enhanced Shovel stability, especially in seated mode
[*] The storage board in the house now updates in real-time
[*] You can now remove poop with other poop 😉
[*] The blinding effect when looking directly into the sun is now less aggressive and appears only after the sun is at a specific height
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that occurred when seeding out super-fast
[*] Fixed a rendering bug with a black line at the fields
[*] Fixed an issue with particles of the shop book
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when very rapidly grabbing and releasing a book repeatedly
[*] Fixed an issue with items that were sold not disappearing proper
[*] Fixed a rare issue with resetting objects automatically when they are out of reach
[*] Fixed a UI display issue when reaching 100 wool with one shearing minigame.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur, when holding the teleport button while night happens and puts you asleep
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when finishing orders after all main orders have been done
[*] Fixed a crash related to starting the game indirectly
[*] Fixed some display issue with Chinese and Japanese language displayed at the fields
[*] Fixed the 10th animal of each type could sometimes not drink anymore and so getting 100% happiness
[/list]
